# Scrollbar

**Class:** `UltraCanvasScrollbar` · **Group:** [Layout and structure](../Groups/Layout-and-structure.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasScrollbar.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasScrollbar.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasScrollbar.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A standalone scrollbar

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasScrollbar> CreateScrollbar( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h, ScrollbarOrientation orientation = ScrollbarOrientation::Vertical);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasScrollbar> CreateVerticalScrollbar( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasScrollbar> CreateHorizontalScrollbar( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasScrollbar(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h, ScrollbarOrientation orient = ScrollbarOrientation::Vertical);
UltraCanvasScrollbar(const std::string& id, float w, float h, ScrollbarOrientation orient = ScrollbarOrientation::Vertical);
UltraCanvasScrollbar(const std::string& id, ScrollbarOrientation orient = ScrollbarOrientation::Vertical);
explicit UltraCanvasScrollbar(ScrollbarOrientation orient = ScrollbarOrientation::Vertical);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

|---|---|---|
| `onScrollChange` | `std::function<void(int)> onScrollChange` | _Scroll change_ |
